purpose.summary: This is a batch COBOL program (SEIKYU4707) that generates a medical fee claim/billing document (請求書) for patients with mental disabilities under a special Okinawa Prefecture treatment payment scheme (沖縄県精神障害者特別措置医療支払請求書, form 121). It reads indexed claim files, computes billing amounts, and produces printed output via job/print management subprogram calls.

notable_features: Extensive use of COPY statements for modular include files (CPCOMMONDAT2.INC, CPSK1001.INC, CPPRTKANRI.INC, etc.)
Japanese Shift-JIS/EUC encoded comments (decoded as latin-1, hence garbled)
CALL to external subprograms: ORCSJOB, and others for print/job management
UNSTRING of COMMAND-PARAM for parameter parsing
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for batch invocation
Indexed file (ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED, ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC)
Revision history embedded in comments spanning 2009–2014
Program option support added in 2013 (FLG-PRGOPTION, PRGOPTION-REC)
Temporary directory handling subprogram (CPORCSGETTEMP.INC) added in ver4.8
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric fields; no EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are Japanese (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is part of the JMA (Japan Medical Association) open-source 'ORCA' medical receipt software project. Multiple COPY statements reference external copybooks not shown. The 34 CALL statements and 62 PERFORMs indicate a substantial, well-structured production program. No COMP-3 is unusual for a billing program but consistent with the indicators.
